bout.notes: Frames 20040-20055 show the conclusion of the previous match. | This bout has a recurring actor-attribution pattern, not a full match-wide swap: Gemini got the standing/opening events and the clean 20630 takedown right (kit colors match), but for the extended half-guard exchanges (20430-20460 and 20640-20755) it appears to have consistently named the athlete who was NOT on top as the 'controller' and the one who WAS on top as the 'guard player' -- backwards in both directions depending on which label was used. Corrected using the unambiguous grey/white kit with visible 'UF / Universal Fighters' team logo as the Hanay anchor, cross-checked against the clean 20630 takedown (black=Ibragimov=attacker, confirmed unambiguously) and against the scramble visible between 20635-20640 that flips top/bottom. Final score in the source bout JSON is 0-0 (win_type DECISION) so no points fields were ever expected here.
